description: Connects a ChatGPT user's erphome.pl apartment-booking account (via OAuth, scoped to their own token) so they can ask, in plain language, about their reservations, guest message history, availability calendar, pricing configuration, guest reviews, and monthly occupancy/revenue stats. Read-only: the app never creates, edits, or sends anything on the user's behalf.
